trace_variant: initial row-wise VAE staged-no-cross, not clean batched-copy timing
scope: complete rank0 RGB-completion windows11–14; eight-rank matching communication names; per-rank device start/end inside global window
limitations: Device communication start includes waits and is not packet-transfer start.
Per-rank clocks are exporter-aligned host/device timestamps; device clock calibration uncertainty is not quantified.

Stream event IDs are not exposed in this DB. Event record and wait links use stream order, CANN connectionId, and coincident communication completion, so explicit record-to-wait event identity remains unverified.
Nested CPU ranges, communication/task waits and kernel workloads cannot be summed as independent latency.
The target layer/probe label must be derived from surrounding send/receive order, not solely collective counter arithmetic.
archival_scope: Prior initial-row-copy, cross-disabled SP8 trace. Not the batched-copy timing variant, not restored combined BSND, and not the historical winner.
